results.note: A CONNECT sent over TLS. The 8.0.0 oracle serves only HTTP/1.1 inside the outer TLS (RelayConnectHandler: an SslHandler is already in the pipeline, so configurePipelines without detection); upstream fix 40939d794 defers detection on every CONNECT, so the snapshot classifies the decrypted first bytes as it does in a cleartext tunnel: a nested TLS record is terminated, the h2c preface is served as HTTP/2. The tunnelled bytes follow the CONNECT after a second (chunkMillis): the oracle opens its loopback to itself before it answers 200, and bytes that arrive while it does so are lost, so a 200 ms gap raced against a cold oracle.
